title: TM30 notifications
description: A foreign occupant who moves in must be notified to the Immigration Bureau within 24 hours. Generate the upload file per building, then record the submission. The platform never submits for you.
noPermission: Only Owners and Managers (TM30 permission) see and handle these.
ruleTitle: Notify within 24 hours of the move-in
ruleBody: The house master must notify the stay of a foreigner. Each deadline comes from the API, counted from the move-in.
overdueCount: {count, plural, one {# notification is} other {# notifications are}} past the deadline
filesHint: Generate a building's file and upload it on the Immigration Bureau's site. Passport numbers exist only inside the file.

empty.title: No TM30 notifications
empty.body: When a foreign occupant moves in, the notification due appears here.

generate.title: Generate the TM30 file of {building}?
generate.body: Generates the Immigration Bureau upload file for the {count} pending notifications of {building}. Passport numbers are decrypted for the file only, and every reveal is audited.
generate.done: File generated — download it from the list

row.markSubmittedBody: Record when you uploaded the file or notified in person, and the receipt reference if any. The deadline reminders stop.
row.submittedAtHint: Defaults to now; never in the future.
row.cancelBody: Only when it is not due after all — for example the nationality was recorded wrongly and the occupant is Thai.

employerFilterBody: Only the foreign workers staying under this employer's leases. The upload file is still made per building.
